verdict.rationale: Metronome documents free trials and time-limited promotional discounts through rate overrides on contracts. Because the overrides are time-limited, reverting to standard pricing after the trial is implied, but it is not explicitly documented as automatic conversion to paid. There is no evidence of coupon or promotion-code redemption, or of trial-end notifications for card-network compliance. Missing for 10: coupon/promotion-code mechanics, explicit automatic trial-to-paid conversion docs, trial-end customer notifications, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can run free trials, coupons, and promotion codes with automatic conversion to paid — including trial-end notifications required by card-network rules

citations.quote: Creating a free trial in Metronome follows the general pattern for discounts: apply a rate override on the customer's contract.
Promotional pricing: Implement time-limited discounts and free trials through overrides
